No duplicate task after all-status search and last-week CI sweep. The meeting landing repair tale will trim the shared page below the cap while preserving both contracts, so do not duplicate that edit; this note records causal ownership and planned integration.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: load-only timing failures, already tracked by bob-cli-km and bob-cli-pg — at bob-plugins c1819664 under load avg ~100/16 cores, npm test failed only event-link-times 200-link 25 ms, frees-marks 200-link/2000-task 25 ms, taskLinks session open 50 ms and taskLinks p95 12 ms; both ledger-tools files passed in isolation and test:perf passed 26/26 once load fell to ~15. block-id-prompt and its perf test are unchanged since pre-phase base 4ecbf218. docs:check word-budget baseline (note #1) now also lists mac-capture/keyboard.md 6019 and mac-capture/protocol.md 6308; the phase touched no docs.

Verified landed settings-rows work in bob-plugins (d55a1759, 7649f6fe, a22851fd; HEAD c1819664): fragment 298w adds props_contract_v1 shape and capability gating, which degrades to generic rows plus 'Update bob for typed settings.'; AREA/PROJECT SETTINGS in contract order with stable setting:: IDs and merged theme/clock keys; ON THE ^PRJ LINE virtual rows with an unavailable state; PROPERTIES, identity/status, and a collapsed BOB-MANAGED fold with a done_tasks archive link; rename, reorder, convert and delete guards on synthetic rows; setting.clear/prop.unset batch mapping with ghost no-op and parent refusal; source-byte copy refusing ghosts and virtual rows; stage-resolver seam propertyEditorResolveSettingStage. The decoders pass contract/effects/warnings through unchanged. Checks: npm run build unchanged; build:check clean; focused test-ledger-tools-property-editor-settings-rows.cjs 19/19; npm test unit 9388/9390 with the 2 failures load-only timing tests that passed in isolation; test:perf 26/26 at lower load; bob plugins sync reported all plugins up to date. docs:check fails only on the pre-existing word-budget baseline (see notes). epic-symbols: none.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: load-only timing failures, already tracked by bob-cli-km and bob-cli-pg — npm test under suite load failed only event-link-times 200-link 25 ms (91.1 ms) and frees-marks 200-link/2000-task 25 ms (150 ms); test:perf typed keystroke p95 14.8/12 ms. Both ledger-tools files passed in isolation on this tree (event-link-times build 5.6 ms) and on clean HEAD c1819664 (event-link-times 4.6 ms, frees-marks 23.0 ms, typed p95 10.98 ms). Unchanged from 6.1.2 note #2.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: docs-check baseline exceeds word budgets — BOB_CLI_DIR=this workspace reported plugin-apis.md 9,287/8,000, mac-capture/keyboard.md 6,019/6,000, mac-capture/protocol.md 6,308/6,000, bob-navigation-hotkeys.md 6,029/6,000. This phase only added a short architecture.md seam paragraph; those inputs match 6.1.2 notes #1/#2.

Verified setting-actions in bob-plugins: fragments 298x/298y after 298w (259/535 lines; 298f stays 933). Summary is one-line with live N/140 (multiline refused, over-140 warns without blocking). Ready cap is 1–999 or off (legacy false→off; o toggles off; effect line uses local noteReady). Review is 1–365 with residence-only help. Capture names reuse the ordered list stage as setting.set. Stats-root Enter is one undoable set-true or clear, never root:false, locked on top-level projects. Temporary generic parent (prose)/color/type/clock stages; clock setting.set is always a {mode, types?} object. Ghost Enter seeds from effectiveValue and writes nothing. Dedicated saves use setting.set; Ctrl+D is setting.clear (ghost no-op, parent refused). Setting batches dry-run via setDraft+previewNow before apply. Confirmed post-apply/undo/redo contract is adopted; dry-run candidates never become the modal report; missing additive contract invalidates and re-reads props show. Resolver seam propertyEditorRegisterSettingStageHandler is documented in docs/develop/architecture.md. Tests: setting-actions 16/16, settings-rows 19/19, related property-editor 128/128. npm run build and build:check clean. bob plugins sync copied ledger-tools main.js (+821) and styles.css. epic-symbols: none. Load-only timing and docs word-budget baselines recorded as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP (bob-cli-km / bob-cli-pg; 6.1.2 notes). No memory edits.
